About Me

Hi, my name is Edgar and I’m a Business Analyst with a strong passion for data analytics. Since deciding to pursue a career in data, I have been fortunate to work with consulting companies alongside a great number of fantastic professionals. I have worked at several companies, where I gained strong teamwork and leadership skills.

Although I believe I still have a long way to go and a lot to learn, I am most skilled in Power BI, as it has been my daily tool for the last couple of years. I adapt well to team environments and I am comfortable working in in-person, hybrid, or remote formats. I am open to relocation and eager to continue developing in this field.

I feel very comfortable working with:

Python and libraries such as “Pandas” and “NumPy”. I also have some experience with web scraping using “BeautifulSoup” and “Selenium”.

SQL for data transformation and analysis.

Tableau and Looker Studio for building professional, client-ready dashboards.
